conformance-evidence.text: As an integrator deciding whether to build on Singular, I read which of the consumer requirements a run of one named code revision demonstrated, which it did not, and how every backend adapter answered the shared contract — and I can check that nothing on this page was typed by hand.

This page is generated by conformance evidence-page from the requirement inventory conformance/rows.json, the application model revision in conformance/model-revision, and the receipts and contract results the CI runs named in the appendix produced for the code revision below. The documentation check regenerates it from those committed files and fails on any difference.

requirements-a-run-did-not-pass.text: Requirements a run did not pass.

requirements-not-demonstrated.text: Every requirement without a receipt for this code revision is listed with the plan the inventory declares for it.

appendix-backend-contract-across-adapter.text: One case list runs against every adapter. A case an adapter cannot exercise is reported for it as not supported, with the reason; it is never counted as passed.

appendix-how-this-page-was-produced.text: Appendix: how this page was produced.
